_comment: Seed registry of NYC neighborhood newsletters on Substack. Discovered by walking
from a hand-picked seed list -- Substack exposes no search or geo API, but
hyperlocal newsletters recommend their neighbours, so the graph clusters by place.
Crawled 2026-08-02: 1519 publications reached, 91 NYC-relevant, 26 local kept here.
All 26 feeds verified live on that date.
`neighborhoods` and `boroughs` are DERIVED by us from name + tagline -- Substack
models no geography whatsoever. That derived tag is the whole basis of filtering.
`kind`: hyperlocal = a neighborhood is named in the title/tagline; borough = only
a borough is. `verified` means the RSS feed responded. `sponsored` is reserved --
nothing sets it yet, but the field exists so paid placement is never a retrofit.
